proves.claim: The Flow panel draws one one-line row per unlanded item with its id and cause, in input order.

view.flow-panel-render.rows-one-line-eac.why: Without it the panel could reorder, merge or wrap rows and hide where the release is stuck.

proves.claim: The Flow panel lists every idle seat with its reason on a single line.

view.flow-panel-render.idle-seats-on-one.why: Without it idle seats could vanish from the panel or spread over many lines.

proves.claim: An empty flow model renders a single quiet empty line, and no Flow markup draws a left-edge accent border.

view.flow-panel-render.empty-model-one-q.why: Without it an idle board could draw a broken panel or bring back the accent border the design language bans.
